title: Affine radicial preparation with geometrically reduced generic fibre before generic-flat shrinking
statement: Let $X$ be affine and $f:X\to T$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $V\subseteq T$ be an affine open containing the image of $f$, and let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$ such that the fibre $X_\eta$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There exist an affine open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$, an integral affine scheme $S$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], a reduced affine scheme $Y$ [def-pc-reduced-scheme], a universal homeomorphism $q:S\to U$ [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], and a locally finite type morphism $g:Y\to S$. There is a generic point $\eta\prime$ of $S$ mapping to $\eta$, the fibre $Y_{\eta\prime}$ is geometrically reduced (its extension to every field extension of the residue field is reduced), and for every $s\in S$ the fibre $Y_s$ is geometrically irreducible if and only if $X_{q(s)}$ is geometrically irreducible. Here $q(s)$ is regarded as a point of $T$. No flatness or finite presentation is asserted for $g$.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_radicial_generic_reduced_preparation
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (himage : Set.range f ⊆ V)
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (U : T.Opens), η ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (S Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : S ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : Y ⟶ S),
        IsAffine S ∧ IsIntegral S ∧ IsAffine Y ∧ IsReduced Y ∧
        IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType g ∧
        ∃ η' : S, IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧ (q ≫ U.ι) η' = η ∧
          GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η') ∧
          ∀ s : S, GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s) ↔
            GeometricallyIrreducible (f.fiberToSpecResidueField ((q ≫ U.ι) s))
